title: Staff Engineer (AI-Native) (Full time contractor)
description: Overview We are looking for a Staff Engineer in LATAM to join the engineering team. In this role, you will set technical direction across both front-end and back-end systems, helping shape the architecture, performance, reliability, and user experience of our learning platform. You will provide hands-on technical leadership across squads, partner closely with Product and Design, and drive the development of scalable, secure-by-default, AI-powered customer experiences. This is a high-impact role for an engineer who can move fluidly across the stack, from high-traffic user interfaces to high-scale services, while mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar across the organization. About Nerdy: At Nerdy (NYSE: NRDY) - the company behind Varsity Tutors - we're redrawing the blueprint of learning. Our Live + AI platform fuses real-time human expertise with proprietary generative-AI systems, setting a new bar for measurable academic impact at global scale. We recruit technologists and operators who turn ambiguous problems into shipping code, iterate faster than markets move, and compound their advantage with every data point. In an era where great employees can deliver 10-times the leverage of the merely good, we back those who play to win. Fortune favors the bold. Join us. How we compete: AI-Native at every level — From the CEO to day-one hires, everyone builds and ships with generative AI. If you're not wielding AI, you're not done. Entrepreneurial velocity — Move at founder speed, prototype in hours, and measure in real user outcomes. Slow teams die. Free-market rigor — Ideas rise or fall on merit and results — no committees, no politics, no cap on upside. Full-stack ownership — You design, build, and run what you ship; accountability is a feature, not a bug. Reward for contribution — Pay rises with impact, not years. Outstanding results earn outsized rewards. We evaluate both what you achieve and how you achieve it: living our leadership principles and using AI effectively are formally measured and rewarded. Relentless exploration — Push the frontier of generative AI in live learning and questioning every legacy assumption along the way. Is Apolitical — You stay focused on mission-aligned outcomes, not distractions or unrelated causes. If you're a technically minded builder who thrives on open competition, personal responsibility, and the chance to redefine how the world learns, come do the most ambitious and rewarding work of your career here. Learn more at nerdy.com. Q4-2025 Shareholder Letter Q3-2025 Shareholder Letter Q2-2025 Shareholder Letter Responsibilities Technical Leadership: Serve as the technical point of reference for the squad and broader engineering team, ensuring best practices in architecture, performance optimization, and accessibility standards are upheld. Solution Design: Lead the design and architectural discussions for systems, making pivotal decisions on frameworks, state management patterns, component architecture, and design systems. Code Quality: Advocate for and ensure the delivery of high-quality, maintainable, and scalable code. Conduct regular code reviews and provide mentorship to team members. Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, designers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements, provide technical insights, and ensure the timely delivery of features. Strategy and Vision: Contribute to the engineering department's strategy and vision, bringing innovative ideas to improve our customer-facing experiences. Problem Solving: Address complex technical challenges, innovate solutions, and optimize existing systems for scalability and performance. Team Development: Mentor and develop team members, helping them to grow in their technical roles and careers. AI Enablement: Leverage AI-native tools and approaches to improve development speed, product capabilities, and engineering effectiveness across the software lifecycle. Qualifications Minimum of 10 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and evolving complex, high-scale systems and customer-facing applications. Strong full-stack expertise, including domain in: Frontend: JavaScript, TypeScript; Backend: JavaScript, Java, Golang. Explicit mentoring of senior-level engineers regularly, leading to results. Significant experience in AWS-based cloud architecture environments. In-depth knowledge of modern software engineering practices, design patterns, and architectures. Experienced with AI-native tools that enhance productivity and speed (Cursor, Make.com, Supabase, Netlify, Claude Code, n8n, Firecrawl, ChatGPT, Grok, Bolt, Vercel, etc). Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Experience designing high-traffic web applications and scalable distributed services. Demonstrated experience in collaborating with multidisciplinary teams. Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. A strong owner willing to roll up their sleeves. This role includes coding and reviewing the code of others. Ability to implement customer-facing solutions that solve the customers\' true needs with exceptional user experiences. Nerdy is an apolitical company focused solely on helping people learn, and we achieve the most when united in this mission. Benefits Competitive USD Compensation: Enjoy a market-leading rate paid in U.S. dollars. 100% Remote (Home Country Only): Work from anywhere in your home country—no relocation required, no borders crossed. Flexible Time Off: Our flexible PTO lets you recharge on your own terms and when you need it the most. Local Holiday Pay: We honor your nation\'s official holidays with paid time off—celebrate what matters to you. Continuous Learning: Get a free, all-inclusive learning membership for you and your household—including 1-on-1 tutoring hours, unlimited on-demand classes, and access to our full suite of learning products and services. Supercharge with AI: Gain exclusive access to cutting-edge AI tools that boost your productivity, making you feel almost super-human (cape not included). Feedback-Rich, Collaborative Culture: Tap into regular training, peer reviews, and a team that treats every team member as a vital collaborator and owner in our success. Make a Global Impact: Your expertise fuels an innovative platform used by learners around the world—be part of something transformative. The Bottom Line: If you're driven by impact, energized by ownership, and excited to help shape what's next, you'll thrive here. We move fast, think big, and reward those who deliver. This isn't a traditional corporate environment - it's a place to do the most meaningful work of your career. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Gerenciar esclarecimentos técnicos dentro das disciplinas e entre os fornecedores de SURF e as contratadas de instalação. Supervisionar as atividades de engenharia relacionadas ao projeto dos sistemas de flexíveis e umbilicais e à instalação do sistema SURF, com foco especial em layout, expansão térmica, análises mecânicas e dinâmicas globais, definição da configuração de risers, instalação e pré‑comissionamento. Revisar e comentar a documentação de engenharia dos fornecedores de URF e das contratadas de instalação , considerando os documentos contratuais de referência. Supervisionar atividades de aquisição, fabricação, testes e instalação relacionadas à disciplina. Auxiliar no acompanhamento de todos os aspectos da construção dos sistemas de flexíveis e umbilicais, incluindo todos os subcomponentes e ferramentas de instalação associadas. Acompanhar os subfornecedores dos fornecedores de URF, participar de auditorias de subfornecedores e assegurar que os requisitos do projeto Lapa tenham sido devidamente transmitidos, compreendidos e atendidos. Gerenciar questões de interface relacionadas à disciplina sob sua responsabilidade, em estreita cooperação com o Gerente Técnico, a contratada de SPS e a contratada de instalação, visando à integração do sistema SURF. Identificar necessidades de assistência técnica da Companhia e coordenar o suporte com especialistas OT/TL. Revisar dossiês e procedimentos de qualificação e acompanhar quaisquer testes de qualificação nas disciplinas de URF e Instalação. Manter o Gerente de UFR informado sobre quaisquer desvios, riscos ou preocupações relacionadas à disciplina, seja em aspectos técnicos, de planejamento ou de custos. Apoiar o Gerente de UFR na avaliação técnica de solicitações de alteração contratual (Change Order Requests) . Reportar ao Gerente de UFR o progresso da disciplina . Acompanhar as atividades dos fornecedores de URF e das contratadas de instalação durante as campanhas de instalação, incluindo mobilização e aceitação de embarcações , com participação de especialistas da matriz da TotalEnergies. Apoiar a resolução de questões offshore durante as campanhas de instalação e coordenar o suporte das contratadas de instalação, da base logística, da contratada de SPS e do site de Lapa (FPSO). Garantir que o estado da arte , os referenciais técnicos da TotalEnergies e as leis e normas locais sejam cumpridos e incorporados a todos os requisitos contratuais de aquisição e instalação, bem como assegurar sua aplicação durante a execução dos contratos em todos os aspectos relacionados à instalação. Fornecer suporte técnico à área de HSE da subsidiária TotalEnergies Brasil para a aceitação de embarcações de instalação. Buscar otimizações e economias ao longo das diferentes fases do projeto, mantendo foco na redução de custos sem comprometer os objetivos de HSEQ . Perfil do Candidato Qualificações e Experiência Requeridas Formação: Graduação em Engenharia ou equivalente, de instituição reconhecida. Experiência Profissional: Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência em engenharia de sistemas UFR e instalação offshore associada. Conhecimento do mercado local e de fornecedores locais . Experiência prévia com contratadas e fornecedores será considerada um diferencial. Competências Comportamentais: Boa comunicação e capacidade de networking. Autonomia na organização do trabalho, com rigoroso autocontrole de qualidade . Alta proatividade. Forte capacidade de síntese . Perfil aberto e interessado em se envolver no desenvolvimento e promoção de competências do ativo operado. Outras Competências: Inglês e Português fluentes #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Lead Security Engineer (GRC)
description: Overview About Nubank: Nubank was founded in 2013 with the mission of fighting complexity to empower people in their daily lives by reinventing financial services. Today, we are one of the largest digital banking platforms in the world, serving millions of customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. For more information, visit our careers page: About The Team The Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) team enables Nubank to remain compliant with legal, regulatory, and internal requirements, while continuously identifying, classifying, and monitoring risks and providing strategic insights and performance evaluation to leadership. The GRC squad collaborates with multidisciplinary teams to align our technology security strategy with Nubank’s overall business objectives, ensuring that identified risks are mitigated and that risk-based decision-making is enabled within and beyond the IT & Security Business Unit. About The Role You will be responsible for acting as a technical reference in security, certifications, and internal controls, serving as a bridge between engineering, risk, audit, and business stakeholders. You will define strategies, support risk-based decision-making, and ensure that security and compliance requirements are effectively embedded into processes, systems, and products. Key Responsibilities Act as a senior technical and governance reference across security, certifications, risk, and internal controls, influencing strategy. Identify control gaps and improvement opportunities in technical procedures required for certification and recertification processes (e.g., ISO 27001, PCI-DSS). Develop and maintain strong partnerships with business and technical leaders to orchestrate audits, assessments, and remediation plans in a risk-based and scalable way. Collaborate with technical teams to define action plans that ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies. Conduct assessments of internal controls, ensuring adherence to internal policies, legal requirements, and industry standards. Identify gaps and improvement opportunities in the internal controls landscape and lead control reviews, ensuring timely resolution of issues. Work closely with Risk teams to align on the mitigation of identified risks. Support responses to audit requests, regulatory inquiries, and due diligence from business partners. Partner with Engineering, Product, IT, and global teams to integrate compliance and security requirements into processes and systems. Define and monitor KRIs and KPIs, delivering forward-looking, data-driven insights to senior management and Committees. Drive continuous improvement and scale, simplifying processes and strengthening Nubank’s Security Maturity as the company grows globally. Qualification Requirements Solid experience in information security, with strong knowledge of frameworks such as PCI-DSS, ISO 27000 family, NIST, and similar. Prior experience with security certification processes and/or internal controls, compliance, and audit support. Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating complex topics into clear, actionable insights for senior leadership and committees. Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields. Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM-based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases. Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations. Hands-on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts. Advanced English (written and verbal) required. Nice To Have Requirements Relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, Security+, CISSP, or CISM are considered a strong plus. International experience is highly desirable. Benefits Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food/ Meal Card (Vale-Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale-Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work-from-home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable Work Model for this Role Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. title: Senior IT Engineer – Global Offices Network
description: Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we’re building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more about our career opportunities here. About The Role We are looking for a Senior IT Engineer to design, implement, and operate our global office and data center network . In this role, you will own the connectivity and performance of Nu’s physical locations, ensuring that our offices and data centers are reliable, secure, and ready to support our next waves of growth. You will work on routing, switching, wireless, security, and observability across our global stack, leading key initiatives such as new office rollouts, critical connectivity improvements, and the evolution towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) . You will be part of the Global Offices Network team, working closely with peers in Connectivity, Security, and Workplace to provide a seamless experience for Nubankers worldwide. What You’ll Be Responsible For Network & Connectivity Design, implement, and support enterprise network infrastructure for offices and data centers, including routing, switching, and wireless. Maintain and evolve high-availability data center fabrics (e.g., spine-and-leaf topologies with Juniper/Cisco hardware). Ensure robust connectivity between offices and data centers, including WAN and SD-WAN solutions, focusing on performance, reliability, and scalability. Wireless, Load Balancing & Security Configure and support wireless networks (controllers and access points), with strong experience in vendors such as Aruba and Cisco. Operate and tune load balancers (e.g., F5, including DNS/ZoneRunner concepts) to guarantee optimal application delivery and resilience. Collaborate with security teams on Next-Generation Firewalls (e.g., Palo Alto, Fortinet) and cloud security brokers (e.g., Zscaler) in a “security-first” network design. Automation, IaC & Observability Drive the transition away from manual configuration towards Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using tools such as GitHub, Terraform, and/or Ansible. Implement and maintain network performance monitoring and observability using tools like PRTG, Prometheus, Grafana, SolarWinds or similar, ensuring proactive detection and resolution of incidents. Manage PKI-related activities, including SSL/TLS certificate lifecycle and ensuring secure encrypted communications across services and endpoints. Delivery & Collaboration Lead or co-lead new office implementations and major network changes, coordinating with Workplace, Connectivity, and other partner teams. Act as a technical reference for incident response and problem management in critical networking issues, helping restore services quickly and preventing recurrences. Document architectures, runbooks, and standards, helping scale knowledge across the team. Mentor more junior engineers and collaborate in a multi-level team (IC6, IC5, IC3, IC4) to continuously improve how we operate our global infrastructure. We Are Looking for a Person Who Has 5+ years of experience in enterprise networking or infrastructure engineering, working with critical environments (e.g., large offices, data centers, or mission-critical operations). Strong hands-on experience with routing and switching, ideally using vendors such as Cisco and/or Juniper. Experience implementing and supporting wireless networks, especially with Aruba and/or Cisco wireless solutions. Solid experience operating network monitoring and performance tools (e.g., PRTG, SolarWinds, Prometheus, Grafana or similar) in production environments. Experience with load balancers (e.g., F5) and DNS-related components (e.g., ZoneRunner or equivalent). Exposure to network security components, such as enterprise firewalls and/or security brokers, and comfort collaborating with security teams in a “security-first” posture. Experience with or strong interest in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and automation for network configuration and lifecycle management (e.g., GitHub, Terraform, Ansible). Ability to lead initiatives and coordinate teams during new office rollouts, complex changes, and incident response. Strong problem-solving skills, ownership mindset, and ability to work in cross-functional, multicultural teams. Intermediate English (spoken and written), with the ability to participate in meetings and collaborate with global teams. Nice to Have Familiarity with Zero Trust network concepts and security-driven networking. Experience with cloud networking (e.g., connectivity to public clouds) and hybrid environments. Experience with security mindset and encryption topics (e.g., secure protocols, network segmentation), even if not your primary specialization. Prior experience in distributed or global organizations. Location This opportunity is based in Brazil , with a strong preference for candidates who can work from our offices in: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil Belo Horizonte, Brazil You will be part of the Brazil Global Offices Network team and collaborate with colleagues in other locations as needed. Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least 2–3 times per week , on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit our article about Nu’s hybrid work model. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more. Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services. Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase. Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours. Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026. Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence. YOUR PROFILE Education Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education. Experience 5-7 years of experience in a similar role. Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage. Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage. Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit. Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset. Skills & Competencies ACCOUNTABILITY : We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact. LEADERSHIP : We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines. INITIATIVE : We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas. DECISION MAKING : We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances. INNOVATION : We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems. VISION : We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization's global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality. INCLUSIVITY : We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams. Certifications & Requirements Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portugues. Any other language is a plus. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools. title: Senior Manager, Ticketing Operations
description: Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue Location: Brazil Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team. THE POSITION Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing the Senior Ticketing Operations Manager will work closely with the FIFA Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure the planning, implementation, and delivery of the ticketing operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™. This role will be responsible for managing the ticketing operations at the stadiums and all ticketing facilities in the host country. Further, this role will oversee the creation and maintenance of seating maps in the ticketing system, as well as the assignment of ticket holders to seats in accordance with FIFA policies. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the Ticketing Operations team in Brazil in the overall tournament planning, ensuring the team has the guidance, resources, and support required to deliver their roles successfully. Foster strong collaboration within the local team and with the Ticketing team in Zurich to ensure consistent operational alignment. Implement system configuration according to the specifications set by the Zurich team, maintaining accuracy and consistency across all platforms. Oversee and manage the ticketing inventory, including the creation, maintenance, and continuous updating of seating plans for all host venues in the ticketing system. Plan, prepare, and supervise the full on‑site ticketing operation, including the setup and management of all required infrastructure and equipment. Develop, implement, and maintain ticketing policies and procedures to ensure operational excellence and compliance with organizational standards. Ensure alignment and coordination with other functional areas as well as the host stadium to support a seamless event delivery. Oversee all electronic access control operations in the host venues, ensuring proper configuration, integration, and match‑day readiness. Plan, schedule, and conduct site visits as required to assess operational needs, validate infrastructure, and coordinate with venue stakeholders. Support general ticketing operations for FIFA events as required. YOUR PROFILE Education / Experience 8+ years of experience in ticketing operations for major sports events, venues, or entertainment properties. Experience delivering ticketing operations for multi‑venue events or international tournaments is strongly preferred. Familiarity with ticketing platforms and access control technologies. Strong operational planning and stakeholder coordination skills. Ability to work in a fast‑paced event environment with multiple deadlines. Proven track record of developing and leading teams. Native‑level fluency in Brazilian Portuguese and English; proficiency in additional languages is valued. Skills & Competencies Leadership and team management Operational planning and execution Stakeholder management Problem solving and decision making Communication and coordination Attention to detail Risk management mindset Certifications & Requirements Willingness to travel to host cities. Availability to work extended hours during test events and tournament time. Experience working in international, multicultural environments preferred. Proven track record of developing and leading teams. Fluent in Portuguese and English Right to work in Brazil Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Concurso Perito e Investigador salários de até R$6.280,31
description: Edital foi autorizado para concurso público de Perito e Investigador da Policia Civil do Rio de janeiro 2019. As 685 vagas estão divididas e 118 delas para o cargo de Investigador e as restantes, 567 para Inspetor da Policia Civil. De acordo com o Governador do Estado do Rio foram autorizadas, além dessas, mais 400 vagas para o cargo de Técnico de Necropsia (80), Auxiliar de Necropsia (60), Perito (60) e Delegado (100). Sobretudo, ainda não foi escolhida a banca organizadora, mas sabe-se que está em fase de propostas. De acordo com a Acadepol (Academia de Policia), oito bancas estão em analise para se decidir qual delas tomará conta do certame. O Concurso de Perito e Investigador terá salários de até R$6.280,31, confira tudo sobre os cargos e a prova. Cargos concurso Perito e Investigador Foto divulgação: Policiais Civis em serviço. É fundamental que o candidato fique por dentro de todas as funções para o cargo que irá concorrer à vaga. Bem, em primeiro lugar é preciso saber quais as atribuições do cargo. Então agora vamos entender as funções, atribuições e também definições dos cargos em questão. Concurso Perito e Investigador confira os cargos: O correto é dizer é Auxiliar Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil, neste caso, cargo cujo nível de escolaridade exigido é o ensino fundamental. Sendo assim, os candidatos podem esperar por grande concorrência para o concurso público, isso porque o salário é de quase R$4.000,00 aproximadamente. Atribuições O Auxiliar de Necropsia é responsável pelo o serviço de limpeza de cadáveres, bem como a limpeza e manutenção do local onde vai trabalhar. 2-Técnico de Necropsia O termo correto para esse cargo é Técnico Policial de Necropsia da Polícia Civil. Todavia, esse cargo exige um nível maior de escolaridade sendo assim o candidato terá que ter o ensino médio, ou seja, não precisa ter formação de técnico de necropsia para concorrer a vaga. Contudo, esse também será um cargo muito concorrido, bem como o de Auxiliar de Necropsia, pois o salário de mais de 5 mil reais aproximadamente. Atribuições O Técnico de Necropsia tem as funções de fazer a autópsia dos corpos e dissecação de cadáveres, sob supervisão direta de Peritos Policiais. Uma dúvida recorrente dos candidatos do Técnico e Auxiliar de Necropsia são sobre o porte de arma e a exigência de carteira de habilitação, nos últimos concursos não se exigia a carteira de motorista, é preciso esperar o edital para concluir essa informação. No entanto, o porte de arma é inerente aos servidores da Policia Civil. As atividades do Inspetor de Policia é estar supervisionando e atento, pois irá coordenar os superiores em assuntos técnicos especializados e fiscalizar a operação. Além disso, a função de segurança, investigações e operações policiais. As carreiras de Inspetor Policial podem ser de âmbito operacional, sendo assim, trabalham com as inteligências policiais e também administrativas nas delegacias. Salário para Inspetor é de R$6.711,29, ou seja, uma remuneração bastante imponente. Para o cargo é exigido nível superior, e geralmente são chamados muitos candidatos. O Investigador de Policia tem a remuneração inicial de R$ 6.108,85 aproximadamente. De acordo com notícias o cargo de Investigador passou por uma modificação e sofreia alterações no nível de escolaridade, mas a liminar foi derrubada e ficou sendo exigido nível médio, para a alegria de todos que já estavam estudando para o concurso. Atribuições Exercer com supervisão e autonomia coordenação e orientação do superior suas atividades de natureza relacionadas ao transporte de autoridades garantindo total segurança, entre outras funções básicas que estão de acordo com o edital do concurso. 5-Delegado de Polícia O Delegado de Policia que fizer o Concurso Perito e Investigador, aprovado em todas as fases do iniciará seu trabalho cumprindo os seguintes deveres: Concorrer para a manutenção da ordem pública; Assegurar a observância da lei; Defender as instituições públicas; Promover a prevenção, a apuração e a repressão das infrações penais; Assegurar o exercício pleno da cidadania e das liberdades individuais; Exercer atividades de nível superior, compreendendo supervisão, planejamento, coordenação e controle, no mais alto nível de hierarquia da Administração Policial do Estado, entre outras funções conforme o edital. Etapas do concurso A prova tem quatro etapas, visto que a primeira a provaobjetiva, com as matérias de língua portuguesa, informática, constitucional,administrativo, penal e processo penal. Além de tudo, lei de drogas e estatutodo direito civil, tudo incluído no edital. O concurso para Perito e Investigador é bastante almejado. Passando pela prova objetiva terá as outras três avaliações: psicotécnico, exame médico e prova de capacidade física. Logo após isso, entrará para a Acadepol para passar pela investigação social. Resumo concurso Perito e Investigador Polícia Civil do Rio O Concurso Perito e Investigador, para o cargo de Auxiliar de Necropsia da Polícia Civil/RJ ,. terá a exigência de nível fundamental e receberá uma remuneração de R$4.743,12. Já para Técnico de Necropsia , é exigido nível médio para o salário de R$5.277,59. O Inspetor dePolícia Civil é necessário nível superior e os aprovados receberão o salário deR$6.280,31. O cargo de Investigador também exige a mesma escolaridade. Para oposto, o salário é de R$5.740,38. A exigência para o cargo de Delegado, no Concurso Perito e Investigador é de nível superior em Direito, devendo com o diploma devidamente registrado para exercer a função com remuneração é de R$18.747,95. Detalhes do concurso Concurso : Perito e Investigador Estado do Rio de Janeiro (PC-RJ) Escolaridade : fundamental, médio e superior #J-18808-Ljbffr

Organizar o trabalho do projeto Apoio a Distância (SAD) que irá começar no Morro dos Cabritos em Copacabana. title: Senior Software Engineer - Node.JS (Remote)
description: Company Description M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems. Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements. Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA. Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer - Node.JS at M3 Global Research , an M3 company. About the Business Unit M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide. M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252and 27001 certifications with the highest quality data collection and project management capabilities that cover the spectrum of quantitative and qualitative techniques utilized today. M3 services incorporate all of the most advanced statistical and attitudinal methodologies allowing clients to provide world-class offerings and support services to their end-client customers throughout multiple industry sectors. Job Description M3 Global Research, an M3 company is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can thrive in a fast-paced environment developing complex applications to join our cutting-edge engineering team. Our ideal candidate would demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts and development lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object-oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices. You'll be responsible for assisting with system design, coding, improving application performance, collaborating with other developers, and assisting with testing. Lead and supervise the development team, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, aligned with Agile methodologies, and meet quality standards. Design, implement, and deliver highly scalable solutions based on modern cloud-based architecture. Continuously develop, release, monitor, and improve our systems and services while fostering a culture of accountability within the team. Set and actively promote software development processes and best practices, providing mentorship to team members. Participate in and facilitate Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives, to ensure alignment and progress tracking. Provide regular status updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and clear communication of progress, roadblocks, and timelines. Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers across the organization to shape high-impact solutions and deliver high-quality applications. Take responsibility for the team’s deliverables, ensuring scope is maintained and work is delivered iteratively while embracing Agile principles. Qualifications Strong expertise in Node.js , with experience building scalable and efficient backend systems and APIs. SQL and familiarity with relational databases like Oracle or similar platforms. Experience with modern front-end frameworks, specifically React or Angular , and familiarity with Bootstrap for UI development. Exposure to additional languages and frameworks such as PL/SQL, Java/JSP, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Ruby, and ColdFusion is beneficial but not mandatory. Proficient with source control tools like Git for collaborative development and versioning. Knowledge of secure coding practices and familiarity with standards like OWASP Top Ten and SANS CWE , with a commitment to adapting to evolving security threats through audits and ongoing education. Team-oriented with exceptional collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written. Exceptional multitasking abilities , capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities effectively. An analytical mindset with superior problem-solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques. Familiarity with mobile-first development and responsive design is a plus. AI and Automation Expectations Strong hands-on experience with modern AI models and coding tools that improve development velocity and software quality. Ability to apply AI across the Node.js lifecycle, including implementation, refactoring, debugging, and unit/integration test creation. Experience using AI to strengthen CI/CD and quality engineering practices (test generation, flaky test analysis, release validation, and review support). Proven ability to design or integrate automation that increases team efficiency, reduces repetitive work, and improves delivery consistency. Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information. Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI-enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects). title: Containerization & Virtualisation Engineer
description: About Canonical Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1000+ colleagues in 70+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times a year in person in interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder‑led, profitable and growing. Technology Focus This is a general selection process for software engineers focused on virtualisation and container technology – from the kernel through userspace. Apply if you are an exceptional Go, Rust or C/C++ engineer and want to work on next‑generation open source VMM or container technology, or related open source networking and storage. Container, virtualisation and cloud infrastructure are essential for modern software deployments. We invest in open source related to application isolation, workload orchestration, system or OCI containers, micro‑service architecture, or cloud infrastructure. Here are some examples of projects underway at Canonical: RustVMM – a new hypervisor for Linux focused on performance, security and operability. Rockcraft – an elevated Docker image experience for the open source community. LXD – a modern system container and virtual machine manager used on Ubuntu, ChromeOS and other Linux platforms, covering low‑level kernel work, filesystems, VMMs, networking, and higher‑level REST API and CLI. Kubernetes (MicroK8s & Charmed Kubernetes) – building on‑rail K8s, Charmed Kubernetes, and operations tooling. OpenStack (Charmed OpenStack, OVN/OVS, Ceph) – delivering cloud platform technologies to large‑scale computing environments. These teams hire system‑level C/C++, Go, Rust and Python developers to work on security‑critical, performance‑critical and mission‑critical code, focused on software delivery, containers, security, sandboxing, application orchestration and management. Location We have remote container and virt engineering roles in every time zone. What You Will Focus On Design and specify new features, building consensus on approach. Engage with upstream communities in your area of expertise. Conduct security analysis and reviews to ensure defence in depth. Create and monitor performance benchmarks to optimise your product. Collaborate proactively with a distributed team. Write high‑quality code to create new features. Debug issues and produce high‑quality code to fix them. Review code produced by other engineers. Discuss ideas and collaborate on finding good solutions. What We Are Looking For in You An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university. Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about an alternative path. Drive and a track record of going above and beyond expectations. Experience working on open‑source virtualisation or container technology. Experience working in the kernel or very low‑level system. Professional written and spoken English. Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred). Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability. Passion, thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments. Ability to travel twice a year for company events up to two weeks each. Additional Skills We Value Performance engineering and security experience. What We Offer You Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person. Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year. Annual compensation review. Recognition rewards. Annual holiday leave. Maternity and paternity leave. Employee Assistance Programme. Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues. Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events. Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Staff IT Engineer - Service Management
description: About Us Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America — and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human. Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Learn more at About The Team The IT team is the operational backbone of Nubank’s internal infrastructure. As the company scales, we’re building the service management foundations that let engineering teams move faster with more confidence — turning IT operations into a strategic advantage, not just a support function. About The Role As a Lead IT Engineer - Service Management, you will own and evolve Nubank’s IT Service Management (ITSM) practice end to end. You’ll design and implement processes, tools, and governance that keep our internal services reliable, auditable, and efficient, enabling engineering teams to focus on high‑impact work while maintaining strong operational controls in a regulated environment. You’ll Be Responsible For Continuing to build and own Nubank's ITSM practice, defining and implementing core ITIL v4 processes: incident, problem, change, service request, and knowledge management. Establishing a service catalog with clearly defined SLAs and OLAs aligned with internal stakeholder expectations. Owning the end-to-end ITSM toolchain (Jira Service Management or equivalent): configuration, workflow design, form logic, SLA rules, and integrations with adjacent systems. Identifying and closing automation gaps — routing, escalation, notifications, and reporting — partnering with engineering teams to reduce manual toil across operations. Defining and tracking operational KPIs (MTTR, SLA compliance, first-contact resolution, change success rate) and building regular reporting cadences for leadership and stakeholders. Establishing a Change Advisory Board (CAB) with structured documentation and approval workflows. Supporting audit and compliance requirements with structured evidence of IT operational controls, essential in a regulated financial environment. Driving ITSM adoption across the organization, creating runbooks, training materials, and documentation that embed service management culture at scale. Mandatory Qualifications 7+ years of experience in IT service management, IT operations, or a related discipline. Deep ITIL v4 expertise; ITIL 4 Foundation or Managing Professional certification strongly preferred. Proven track record of building ITSM practices from scratch or significantly transforming an existing function. Hands‑on experience owning and configuring ITSM tooling end-to-end (Jira Service Management, ServiceNow, or equivalent) — not just using it, but designing it. Ability to work cross‑functionally in a fast‑paced, engineering‑led environment, with strong influence‑without‑authority skills. Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to present to senior leadership. Nice‑to‑have Qualifications Experience in fintech, high‑growth tech, or other regulated industries. Familiarity with adjacent frameworks: COBIT, ISO 20000, or SRE principles. Experience partnering with Security and/or Platform Engineering teams. Fluent English. What We Offer Greenfield, high‑visibility scope: you’ll define what “good” ITSM looks like at Nubank’s scale — from zero. Direct exposure to senior leadership across IT and Engineering. A culture that values ownership and getting foundations right, without bureaucracy for its own sake. Our Benefits – Brazil Chance of earning equity at Nubank Food/Meal Card (Vale‑Refeição and/or Vale Alimentação) Public Transportation Commuting Benefit (Vale‑Transporte) NuCare – Psychological, Financial and Legal Assistance Program Life Insurance Medical Plan Dental Plan NuLanguage – Language Course Program Nucleo – Our learning platform of courses Extended Parental Leave Daycare Allowance Parental Consultancy Work‑from‑home Allowance Gym Partnerships 30 days of paid vacation Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable (For hybrid roles, commuting‑related benefits such as Vale‑Transport and gym partnerships remain applicable.) Work Model for This Role Hybrid – 2–3 times per week in the office. Explore How We Build Technology At Nubank building.nubank.com.br youtube.com/@building.nubank Our stories on Spotify Diversity & Inclusion At Nubank, we want to be sure that we’re building a more diverse and inclusive workplace that reflects the customers we serve and seek to empower. That’s why we hire based on equality. We consider gender, ethnicity, race, religion, sexual orientation, and other identity markers as enriching elements to our company, while ensuring none of them represent a barrier when recruiting fantastic talent. How to Apply If you’re excited about building a robust IT Service Management foundation that enables Nubank to scale with reliability and speed, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and help us shape the future of financial services in Latin America. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Além de te apresentar possíveis pares e liderança. ✅Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiãs da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar. Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos. Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares: ⚡Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio. Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado. No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

title: Executivo/a de Vendas Regional Indiretos
description: Executivo/a de Vendas Regional Indiretos Acreditamos no potencial de todas as pessoas para dar aaasas a pessoas e ideias independente de expressão de gênero, raça, religião, orientação afetivo-sexual, origem, idade e deficiência. No mundo da Red Bull, todas as pessoas são bem-vindas. title: Frontend Developer Pl
description: A Nuuvem, uma líder na distribuição digital de jogos na América Latina, é conhecida por sua paixão profunda por jogos e uma forte presença no mercado. Estamos em busca de talentos para fazer parte da nossa guilda de pro players, conquistando muito XP ao longo do caminho. Estamos à procura de uma Pessoa Desenvolvedora Frontend Pleno, focada em criar e implementar interfaces web bonitas, modernas, resilientes e fáceis de usar para nos ajudar a manter e evoluir nossa plataforma, além de participar de um novo e importante projeto que estamos lançando este ano. O foco principal desta função é desenvolver e implementar webapps usando técnicas modernas e responsivas de Javascript, HTML e CSS. Você se juntará a uma equipe de entusiastas da indústria de jogos e da web altamente qualificados, criando soluções em um ambiente ágil e apaixonado. O trabalho em equipe é essencial, além de ser um buscador de conhecimento e autossuficiente quando necessário. Esta vaga é para se juntar ao time que está construindo o spawnd, a plataforma de webgaming da Nuuvem. Você precisa ser obcecado em produzir código de alta qualidade rapidamente, visualizando qualquer funcionalidade como parte do valor total da plataforma, sem perder o foco em entregar resultados. Segurança e desempenho devem ser suas prioridades principais.

title: TÉCNICO I - Zona Oeste/ Rio de Janeiro
description: Descrição da vaga Manter os equipamentos em perfeito estado de funcionamento, manutenção técnica, limpeza geral, acompanhamento de terceiros na solução dos problemas quando estes fogem de nossa alçada, testes e vistorias frequentes nos dispositivos de segurança, conservação do aspecto visual, iluminação do ponto, implantação, com isso visando a satisfação do cliente. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar os atendimentos operacionais dos PCs afim de: Repor suprimentos, papel e filtro de ar, substituição de consumíveis e troca de peças, baixar aplicativo, realizar vistoria dos PCs, verificando se está em perfeitas condições, acompanhar fornecedores para reparos técnicos, configurar softwares, manter atualizada a comunicação visual do ponto. Reparo troca dos componentes que apresentarem defeito do equipamento, identificado através de conhecimento técnico. Liberar o ponto para que o responsável pela manutenção (pode ser da concessionária de Telecomunicações, empreiteiro, empresa que faz manutenção), possam executar reparo no defeito. Garantir a boa sinalização e iluminação dos pontos, seus aspectos visuais como pintura, adesivos, sujeira, etc., utilizando materiais de limpeza e peças de reposição, além do acionamento de empreiteiras no caso de fugir de minhas atividades. Requisitos e qualificações Escolaridade: Técnico completo em elétrica, eletrônica, mecatrônica, mecânica, informática ou afins; Conhecimentos de microinformática (hardware e software); Imprescindível saber dirigir e ter CNH B definitiva; Disponibilidade para trabalhar finais de semana e feriados (escala 5x2). #J-18808-Ljbffr

Acompanhar os estudos de desenvolvimento dos ativos, respeitando estritamente o Referencial Técnico, garantindo segurança de design e eficiência energética. Fornecer inputs e compilar os pacotes de suporte à decisão para preparação do FID – incluindo aspectos técnicos, de negócio e comerciais. Preparar o processo de validação dos projetos de desenvolvimento. Acompanhar as punch lists dos projetos concluídos, bem como seus respectivos orçamentos. title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description: We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division‑level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross‑org architectural decisions, negotiate trade‑offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high‑impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1‑click insurance products). 2026's vision and (how this role contributes) In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data‑driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences , (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants , and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations . This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance . Mission design and operationalize the 2–3 year technical end‑state for the Digital Ecosystem so that: NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU), Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue, Insurance launches and scales high‑quality one‑click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture. Core responsibilities Support defining the division’s technical end‑state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade‑offs (cost × latency × availability). Co‑own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs. Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real‑time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX. Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one‑click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS). Support one‑stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech‑debt management to avoid blocking growth. Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle. Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post‑mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross‑BU initiatives. Represent the division in cross‑org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively. Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators. Key business & engineering metrics you will influence NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share‑of‑checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic. Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch. Insurance: one‑click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes. Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners. Challenges and opportunities (what you’ll own) World‑class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first‑layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB). Real‑time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low‑latency ads decisioning and NuPay real‑time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance. One‑click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one‑click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control. Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC. Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One‑Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost‑effective infra. What you’ll find in the team High‑calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers. Complex, high‑impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real‑time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi‑partner dependencies. Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders. What you’ll navigate Heavy cross‑BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration. Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re‑architecture or open‑scheme decisions. Dependence on third‑party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations. Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics. Trade‑offs between accelerating one‑stack migration and accepting short‑term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Fully Remote (North America / South America) There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations. No agencies. About Maximus Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. title: Engineer - Pipe System Design
description: Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide. As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil. You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design. Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications. Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management. Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies. Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables. Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B. About You At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies. To succeed in this role, you typically have: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline. Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary). Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools. Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage. Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams. Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly. Professional proficiency in English. Why Join NOV SPS? Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea. Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply. At NOV, you will find: A collaborative and international work environment Opportunities to work on cutting‑edge offshore engineering solutions Competitive compensation and benefits Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. title: Technical Support Agent - Brazil, 12-9pm BRT
description: About Canals Canals is a fully remote, profitable startup transforming the industrial supply chain ($10T industry) with AI. Our platform seamlessly integrates with the systems distributors already use, automating tedious tasks and reducing failure points in moving physical goods across the globe. We’re an 80‑person team (~50 in engineering), located across North and South America. The Role We’re hiring a Technical Support Agent to help distributors get fast, effective support as they scale on Canals. Our customers rely on our platform for mission‑critical workflows — and maintaining a 1‑minute average response time is part of what sets our team apart. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, guide users through our tools, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure a seamless customer experience. You’ll also gain exposure to the systems that power our platform — working with tools like Zendesk, Postman, FullStory, and SQL to diagnose and resolve issues. If you’re a sharp communicator with strong technical instincts and love solving problems quickly and clearly, this role is for you. What You’ll Do Respond to customer inquiries via live chat and email, maintaining our 1‑minute average first response time. Troubleshoot product and integration issues, escalating when needed to Support Engineers or Product. Use Postman to test API endpoints and SQL to run basic queries for debugging or validation. Investigate customer behavior and issues using FullStory session data. Collaborate closely with CSMs and the Solutions team to ensure smooth onboarding and post‑launch support. Document resolutions and update internal Zendesk macros and knowledge base articles. Identify recurring issues and propose process or product improvements. What You'll Bring Typically, 1–3 years of experience in technical support for a SaaS product. Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you explain technical issues clearly and concisely. Ability to translate complex topics for non‑technical users. Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable in a fast‑moving startup environment. A genuine sense of urgency — you take pride in speed and quality. Bonus Points You’ve used tools like Postman, Zendesk, or FullStory to diagnose and resolve issues. You’ve worked in a startup or early‑stage environment and helped shape support processes or playbooks. You have experience supporting non‑technical customers in industrial, logistics, or distribution contexts. You’ve built or refined internal support workflows, macros, or dashboards. Why Join Canals Real‑world impact: your work improves global supply chains, saving customers time and reducing waste. Strong engineering culture: we invest in quality and documentation to keep moving fast sustainably. Culture of ownership: moving fast while putting quality first. Remote‑first, flexible work environment across North and South America. Stellar product‑market fit with tons of customer love. All‑star team with diverse backgrounds to collaborate with and learn from. Canals.ai is an equal opportunity employer. In addition to EEO being the law, it is a policy that is fully consistent with our principles. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to status as a protected veteran or a qualified individual with a disability, or other protected status such as race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, pregnancy or age. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Human Rights Manager
description: Department Social Responsibility & Education Location Brazil Job Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Position The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism. As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period. Key Responsibilities Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights. Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone. Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms. Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities. Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil. Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics. Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer. Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities. Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits. Your Profile A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices. Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights. 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes. Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments. Excelente comunicação, negociação e capacidade de conduzir conversas complexas com diferentes perfis técnicos e não-técnicos. Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas; Elaborar mensalmente no Word, gerando cópias e distribuindo em locais de livre acesso aos colaboradores um jornal interno, imputando informações preventivas e atualidades, para fins de fornecer informações e gerar uma integração; Preencher eventualmente uma planilha enviada pelo Porto de Itaguaí, constando a entrada e a saída de resíduos da oficina, entregando ao Chefe de Oficina, que é responsável pelo recolhimento, para fins de conformidades junto à FEEMA; Representar eventualmente, a empresa na CPATP (Comissão de Prevenção de Acidentes de Trabalhadores;Portuários), participando de reuniões ordinárias e semestrais para fins de justificar problemas e tomar as devidas providências; Planejar, coordenar, orientar tecnicamente, avaliar e realizar estudos, avaliações e inspeções das condições de trabalho, quanto aos aspectos de higiene industrial, segurança industrial e meio ambiente, em áreas, equipamentos, instalações; Elaborar documentação necessária para a abertura da Comunicação de Acidente de Trabalho e encaminhar para o Setor de Recursos Humanos para que seja emitida; Orientar os membros da CIPA para os assuntos ligados a saúde e higiene, através da participação em reuniões e da realização de palestras na semana de prevenção da empresa, visando prevenir doenças e acidentes do trabalho; title: Engenheiro(a) de Planejamento e Desenvolvimento
description: Contexte et environnement Cargo localizado no escritório do Rio de Janeiro. Atividades de Planejamento Coordenar a preparação do Long Term Plan, Budget, TCM dos ativos, bem como os exercícios regulatórios (FDP, PATPAP) reunindo os inputs (pressupostos técnicos/econômicos/financeiros) e os outputs (apresentações) das diversas disciplinas. Atividades de Desenvolvimento Preparar a estratégia de desenvolvimento dos Ativos Operados Gerenciar interfaces e integração técnica entre diferentes entidades (Geociências, Poços, Operações de Campo, Projetos, Economistas…) para avaliar oportunidades (criação de valor, custos, cronograma, riscos). Coordenar os Planos de Desenvolvimento de Campo (FDP): desde a emissão inicial até a aprovação governamental. Coordenar quaisquer estudos de desenvolvimento e avaliações econômicas necessárias para preparar ou atualizar os FDPs. Acompanhar os estudos de desenvolvimento dos ativos, respeitando estritamente o Referencial Técnico, garantindo segurança de design e eficiência energética. Fornecer inputs e compilar os pacotes de suporte à decisão para preparação do FID – incluindo aspectos técnicos, de negócio e comerciais. Preparar o processo de validação dos projetos de desenvolvimento. Acompanhar as punch lists dos projetos concluídos, bem como seus respectivos orçamentos. Responsável pelo GHG Reporting Responsável por todas as bases de dados de HQ relacionadas a emissões, garantindo que todas as emissões sejam capturadas. Liderar a filial na identificação adequada, reporte e redução das emissões de metano. Principal interface com equipes HSE/ENV quanto à evolução de GHG/CFR. Responsável pelo cálculo e reporte das emissões dos Ativos Operados para todos os exercícios orçamentários e Long Term Plan. Melhorar o reporte atual e visibilidade dos projetos relacionados a GHG/consumo de energia via Power BI. Parceiros / Stakeholders / Autoridades Organizar/participar de workshops e reuniões relacionadas a CFR com stakeholders-chave, incluindo autoridades. Atuar como agente influenciador junto aos parceiros da TotalEnergies EP Brasil no que diz respeito à redução de emissões. Preparar e apresentar os KPIs das emissões dos Ativos Operados durante todas as reuniões com parceiros. Responsabilitás Acompanhar a estratégia de desenvolvimento dos ativos com rigoroso respeito aos padrões de segurança. Gerar informações técnicas disponíveis, completas, coerentes e validadas para os Ativos Operados (planejamento, custos, valor) para uso interno (budget, LTP, decisões gerenciais) e externo (parceiros, governo). Garantir a adequada preparação, execução e entrega de temas CFR/GHG nos exercícios de planejamento (LTP, Budget). QA/QC de todos os dados consolidados e transmitidos. Profil du candidat Graduação em Engenharia. Pelo menos 5 anos de experiência em Upstream Oil & Gas, com experiência em atividades operacionais. Conhecimento avançado de ferramentas como Excel e Power BI Conhecimento e cultura de HSE. Background técnico sólido e amplo para garantir coordenação transversal entre entidades (Geociências, Poços, Planejamento, Economia, Execução de Projetos, Operações de Campo, Finanças e Controle de Custos). Fortes habilidades de comunicação; capacidade de adaptação e gestão de tarefas diversas em contextos variados; reconhecida habilidade de síntese e escuta. Autonomia na organização do trabalho, rigor para produzir resultados/informações validados e sensibilidade à inovação. Fluência em português e inglês. Informations supplémentaires TotalEnergies valorise la diversité, promeut le développement individuel et offre des opportunités d'emploi égales à tous les candidats. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: MEDICO NEUROPEDIATRA DIARISTA- HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description: Job type: Full-time employee Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes . OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia. Responsável pelo atendimento especializado a crianças e adolescentes com distúrbios neurológicos, atuando no diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de condições que afetam o desenvolvimento do sistema nervoso central e periférico. Atua em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares, contribuindo para a reabilitação e melhoria da qualidade de vida dos pacientes. Principais Atividades: Realizar consultas ambulatoriais e hospitalares com enfoque neurológico pediátrico. Diagnosticar e tratar doenças como epilepsia, paralisia cerebral, autismo, TDAH, distúrbios do desenvolvimento, entre outras. Solicitar e interpretar exames complementares (eletroencefalograma, neuroimagem, testes genéticos, etc.). Prescrever medicamentos e tratamentos adequados de acordo com o diagnóstico. Elaborar relatórios, laudos médicos e pareceres técnicos. Acompanhar o desenvolvimento neurológico dos pacientes, realizando avaliações periódicas. Trabalhar de forma integrada com psicólogos, fonoaudiólogos, terapeutas ocupacionais, fisioterapeutas e demais profissionais. Orientar familiares sobre diagnósticos, tratamentos e prognósticos. Participar de reuniões clínicas, discussões de caso e programas de educação continuada. Graduação em Medicina com diploma reconhecido pelo MEC. Residência médica em Pediatria. Residência ou especialização em Neurologia Pediátrica. Experiência de 6 meses na função. Registro ativo no Conselho da Classe. Local: Jacarepaguá/RJ Escala: 20h semanais Horário: a combinar #J-18808-Ljbffr
