title: Head of Legal
description: About InPlanet InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold: to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care and performance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here About the Role We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process. Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks Manage external network of trusted legal advisors Core working relationships Directly reporting to the CFO. Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies Context of the role: You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD) The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact Key Responsibilities Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory) Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including: Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements) Own cross-border legal strategy and execution Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international) Work closely with tax advisors Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement Support investor relations from a legal standpoint Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure You can be a Rock-Star if you have Core Skills & Experience Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil) 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors Proven experience in: Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle Due diligence (legal & regulatory) Complex contract structuring and negotiation International contracts and cross-border operations Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas) Solid experience with: Corporate law and governance Investor relations and strategic partnerships Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments Key Qualities Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters Bonus Points (but not essential) Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms Exposure to governance and international structures Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.) Business and legal experience in Germany Speaks German Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP Living Our Values At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal. Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change Benefits Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency. title: Técnico(a) de Gasodutos II (Instrumentação)
description: A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás. Nossos Valores Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos. Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade. Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados. Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários. Descrição da Vaga Estamos em busca de um(a) Técnico(a) de Gasodutos para nossa base operacional de Campos Elíseos. O(a) profissional será responsável pela plena operação dos equipamentos, sistemas e instalações inerentes a operação através de manutenções preventivas e corretivas, inspeções, calibrações e testes (estações, ecomp, faixa de dutos), objetivando o atingimento da excelência operacional e melhoria contínua dos indicadores. Responsabilidades Atuar nas manutenções corretivas e preventivas dos ativos da NTS, principalmente na estação de compressão (ECOMP), pontos de entrega de gás natural e válvulas (SVDs) da faixa de dutos. Ser responsável pela manutenção e operação dos CLPs, sistemas de comunicação, CCMs, quadro de distribuição, UPSs, geradores, instrumentos, transmissores, sistemas de supervisão, controle local da estação de compressão (ECOMPs), diagnósticos de falhas, testes operacionais e aferições/calibrações. Requisitos Formação técnica em Instrumentação, Automação, Elétrônica ou Mecânica. Experiência no setor de óleo e gás ou indústrias de processos. Vivência com manutenções em equipamentos de processo (Válvulas de controle, Calibração em medidores de nível, temperatura e pressão, conhecimento de CLPs). Diferencial Inglês básico. Por que trabalhar conosco? Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo. Oferecemos oportunidades reais de aprendizado e evolução profissional, com programas estruturados e incentivo ao protagonismo de carreira. Nosso pacote de benefícios é completo e pensado para cuidar de você em todas as fases da vida. Experience operating in regulated and global environments, including interaction with auditors and regulators. Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Technology, Security Information, Risk Management or related fields. Familiarity with using AI and automation (e.g., machine learning, generative AI, or LLM‑based tooling) to enhance security compliance use cases. Knowledge of the regulatory landscape relevant to financial services, such as SOx, BACEN, CVM, CNBV, ANBIMA, SEC, and related regulations. Hands‑on experience with cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP) and implementing security controls in these contexts. Advanced English (written and verbal) required.
